breaking.member: UI CSS position: absolute and fixed (top, right, bottom, left, inset)
breaking.change: Layout change: an absolute or fixed box's insets and percentage sizes are measured from its containing block's padding edge, inside the holder's border, as in CSS. They were measured from the holder's outer (border) edge, so a box at top: 0; left: 0 sat on the holder's border.
breaking.fix: Where an inset made up for the border (top: 2px under a 2px border), set it back to the intended distance from the padding edge (top: 0).
